name: codex-notebook-context
description: Automatically supply the active notebook cell, cursor and selection to Codex prompts via a local hook.

commands.title: Notebook Context for Codex: Install Prompt Hook
Notebook Context for Codex: Remove Prompt Hook
Notebook Context for Codex: Preview Current Context
Notebook Context for Codex: Show Diagnostics

codexNotebookContext.enabled.description: Supply the whole active cell (including unsaved text), cursor and selection on eligible Codex prompts. Context enters Codex conversation storage. Disable to stop future collection.

codexNotebookContext.maxCellCharacters.description: Maximum characters of the active cell to include, centered near the cursor when truncated.

codexNotebookContext.nodePath.description: Optional absolute standalone Node.js 20+ executable path. Otherwise discovered automatically.

codexNotebookContext.codexHome.description: Optional Codex home directory. Must match the directory used by the Codex IDE extension. Defaults to CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.

codexNotebookContext.allowUntestedCodex.description: Opt in to an untested Codex extension version. Review compatibility and verify an ordinary sidebar prompt. Delivery may fail after Codex changes.
